text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Connect the harness connector between the battery temperature sensor harness (front) and battery temperature sensor harness (rear).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Install the Li-ion battery heater RR1 and RR2. Refer to EVB-228, "LI-ION BATTERY HEATER : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Install the Li-ion battery controller. EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".

text_elements.text: REAR MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: WARNING:
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug for shutting off high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to put the removed service plug in pocket and carry it or store it in a tool box or other container so that another person does not accidentally connect it while work is in progress.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to put on insulating protective gear before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Clearly identify the persons responsible for high voltage work and ensure that other persons do not touch the vehicle. When not working, cover high voltage components with an anti-static cover sheet or similar item to prevent contact with other persons.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Refer to EVB-6, "High Voltage Precautions".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: If the battery pack is to be disassembled, be sure to remove the Li-ion battery controller for preventing electric shock, fire, and damage to parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Must be an indoor environment.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The environment must utilize a shutter or other means to shut out the outside environment and prevent rain, snow, dust, or other substances from entering.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The environment must not cause the intrusion of sweat during work, or cause condensation to occur due to high temperature or humidity.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances must not enter.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The indoor environment must also prevent metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances from entering due to maintenance performed on other vehicles and other sources during disassembly work.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: EVB
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: If there is a risk of the above substances entering, take appropriate countermeasures, such as use of a vinyl curtain or an equivalent to shut out the outside environment.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The floor must be dry.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The floor must not be wet as a result of factors such as vehicle entry during rain or snow.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Work space
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The work space must be approximately the size of one entire vehicle.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Take appropriate countermeasures so that persons other than the operator do not enter the work space, such as by placing signs indicating that disassembly work is in progress.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Standard fire fighting equipment
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: DISASSEMBLY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove harness bracket , and from the rear module stack.

text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Follow the following procedure and remove the bus bar from the rear module stack.

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: ASSEMBLY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: When replacing the Li-ion battery with a new battery, perform the following operation.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Enter the date of the (replacement) work on the EV battery tracking identification seal that is packaged together with the new part.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Cut the EV battery tracking identification tool into 2 pieces and apply them to the body of the replaced (old) LI-ion battery and to the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Enter the necessary information in the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Follow the procedure below to assemble the rear module.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Assemble the rear module so that the module terminals are arranged as shown in the figure.

text_elements.text: WARNING: Be careful of the directions of the + terminal and -terminal when assembling the module. If the polarity is incorrect, there is a risk of electric shock, fire, and component damage.
